==Characteristics==
==={{BotW|-}}===

{{Compendium/Extract|Stalhorse}}
A Stalhorse is an undead skeletal [[Horse]] reanimated by [[Ganon]]'s magic.<ref name="BotW Compendium">{{Cite|This skeletal horse is ridden by monsters. It was once a regular horse, but Ganon's power revived it from death. It cannot maintain its bone structure in the daytime.|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref> However, Stalhorses behave and function like regular Horses and pose no threat to [[Link]]. They only appear at night, as they cannot maintain their bone structure during the day.<ref name="BotW Compendium"/> If a Stalhorse is present as the sun rises, it will fall to pieces and disappear. They are usually encountered with [[Stalkoblin]]s or [[Bokoblin]]s riding on their backs.

Despite its lack of stomach, Stalhorses can eat both [[Carrot]]s and [[Apple]]s like a living Horse, though they cannot be registered at a [[Stable]]. If Link tries to register a one at a Stable, the Stable owner will call it a monster and refuse to board it, as it might eat the other Horses.<ref>{{Cite|What in Hylia's name?! That's a monster, not a horse! Sorry, but we can't board that... thing here. It might eat the other horses.|Varke|BotW}}</ref> However this is apparently superstition, as Stalhorses are shown to behave identically to their living counterparts. Stalhorses will not harm any Horses tamed by Link, and wild Horses will not flee when they detect them. Domesticated livestock such as [[Hateno Cow]]s, [[Highland Sheep]], [[White Goat]]s, and [[Hylian Retriever]]s will flee from Stalhorses due to their monstrous appearance. Wearing the [[Radiant Set]] or [[Phantom Ganon Set]] causes Stalhorses to run at high speeds when ridden.

Stalhorses serve a role in the "[[Stalhorse: Pictured!]]" [[Side Quest]]. If [[Juannelle]] is spoken to at [[Snowfield Stable]], she will state that she has heard there is a Stalhorse is in the area, but it is too cold for her to search for it.<ref>{{Cite|I heard there was a {{Color BotW|Red|Stalhorse}} in this area, but I can't take it any longer! It's too cold to look anymore!|Juannelle|BotW}}</ref> Juannelle will offer to give Link a reward if he brings her some notes or a [[Picture]] of the Stalhorse.<ref>{{Cite|Can you handle this task for me? I'll even reward you! All I need is a picture! Or some notes!|Juannelle|BotW}}</ref> Based on the rumor, she advises Link to try and find a Stalhorse, along with its Stalkoblin rider in the [[N. Tabantha Snowfield]],<ref>{{Cite|There's a rumor that it can be found with Stalkoblins in the {{Color BotW|Blue|North Tabantha Snowfield}}.|Juannelle|BotW}}</ref> but she states that a Picture of a Stalhorse from any location would work. If a [[Picture]] of the Stalhorse is shown to Juannelle, she will be startled by its appearance, saying that it looks like a [[Monster]].<ref>{{Cite|Wha-? This is the {{Color BotW|Red|bony horse}}? That {{Color BotW|Blue|Stalhorse}}... It's a monster!|Juannelle|BotW}}</ref> She then rewards Link with a [[Silver Rupee]] and the Side Quest is complete.<ref>{{Cite|Here's your reward, just as I promised!|Juannelle|BotW}}</ref>

If Link speaks to [[Baddek]] while he is on his way to [[Serenne Stable]] from the [[Breach of Demise]], he mentions that he once rode a boney Horse that he encountered in the [[Tabantha Tundra]], recalling that it was a surprisingly comfortable mount.<ref>{{Cite|I love every little thing about horses. I love their fur, the way they smell, their bones even. Speaking of bones, I once rode a horse made of nothing but bones! No lie! It was way up in the snowy mountains. Was I scared, you ask? Nope. I could never be scared of a horse. That bony horse ran really well, and it was actually a surprisingly comfortable ride.|Baddek|BotW}}</ref> Like [[Konba]], Baddek considers the Stalhorse to be a type of Horse.

Stalhorses reappear in {{TotK}}. They are once again skeletal [[Horse]]s ridden by [[Monster]]s, and are revived in locations where [[Gloom]] is highly concentrated.<ref name="TotK Compendium">{{Cite|A skeletal horse often ridden by monsters. These animals, which used to be ordinary horses, are said to be revived in areas where there is a high gloom concentration. They can only maintain their forms in darkness, and they have the remarkable ability to run atop gloom.|Hyrule Compendium|TotK}}</ref> They can be found in areas with large amounts of Gloom, such as the [[Depths]], or in select locations on the [[Surface]] at night.<ref>{{Cite|At night, it appears... The Stalhorse...running atop the gloom...|Malanya|TotK}}</ref> Stalhorses can only maintain their forms in [[Darkness]], disintegrating when exposed to sunlight.<ref name="TotK Compendium"/> They can safely be ridden over patches of [[Gloom]].<ref name="TotK Compendium"/>

==Trivia==
* The Stalhorse is one of nine rideable [[Creature]]s in {{BotW|-}}. The other eight are the [[Horse]], the [[Giant Horse]], the [[White Horse]], the [[Lord of the Mountain]], the [[Mountain Buck]], the [[Mountain Doe]], the [[Grizzlemaw Bear]], and the [[Honeyvore Bear]].
** Of these mounts, the Stalhorse is is one of six that cannot be registered at a Stable.
